-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "app"."tasks" (
  "id" integer not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "app"."touch"() returns trigger language plpgsql volatile security invoker as $okm$begin return new; end$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create trigger "tasks_touch" before update on "app"."tasks" for each row when (old.title IS DISTINCT FROM new.title) execute function "app"."touch"();

create table "app"."tasks" (
  "id" integer not null,
  "title" text not null,
  constraint "tasks_pkey" primary key ("id")
)
create function "app"."touch"() returns trigger language plpgsql volatile security invoker as $okm$begin return new; end$okm$
create trigger "tasks_touch" before update on "app"."tasks" for each row when (old.title IS DISTINCT FROM new.title) execute function "app"."touch"()
